findings.reason: the guard must be widened to `PACKAGED_MACHINE_MAP_ROOT`/`PACKAGED_MAP_ROOT` readers (or the reader must be named and routed to the bundle), otherwise §1's own "every census hit resolves through the bundle" rule is unverified for this file.
findings.text: §1's move takes the jt-60sa unit table out of `imas_ambix/data/machine_maps/`, but the test reads it as `PACKAGED_MACHINE_MAP_ROOT / "jt-60sa-eddb-units.json"` (a second addressing path to the packaged map root beside the bundle resolver), and the done-when grep `git grep -n -E 'data/maps/jt-60sa|machine_maps/jt-60sa' -- packages imas_ambix tests scripts` cannot see it because the path is composed from the constant, not written literally — running that grep at HEAD returns only `scripts/vacuum_loop_adjudication.py:1088` (which §1 moves) and a docstring at `tests/data/test_jt60sa_machine_map.py:3`, so the guard passes while a reader still builds the retired in-repo path. Every constant-composed read of the jt-60sa packaged root is this one site (`test_jt60sa_signal_maps.py:38`); the other `PACKAGED_MACHINE_MAP_ROOT` readers are mast-only and unaffected.

rubric_items.deep_module: pass — §1 adds no module; it removes surface (two machine-named store-root roles leave imas_ambix/data/bundle.py) and routes a script to an existing resolver, so there is no spread of new wrappers to judge as shallow.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: a finding — §1's second done-when grep cannot see a reader that builds the old in-repo map path through `PACKAGED_MACHINE_MAP_ROOT`, and one such jt-60sa reader survives the move undetected.
rubric_items.interface_budget: pass — public_definitions 0, cli_options 0, mcp_views 0, refusal_families 0; §1 retires interface (two `bundle.py` store-root roles, the `cli.py --machine` jt-60sa help example) and adds none, so it names its retirements and nothing to merge.
rubric_items.reuse_search: pass — §1 cites the existing machinery it keys on rather than inventing any: `load_packaged_signal_map` (packages/imas-alambic/src/imas_alambic/signal_map.py:638, which resolves through `bundle_for_machine`), `paths.py` as the /work owner, `bundle.py`'s store-root registry, and §8's `resolve_store_root. The census command reproduces at HEAD (20 files) and matches the plan's list.
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: pass — the script move targets `load_packaged_signal_map`, which already resolves by machine/system through the bundle (signal_map.py:638 calls `bundle_for_machine(machine).signal_map_path(...)`), so it is an extension-by-use of the owner rather than a parallel wrapper.
